integrity: The result follows by exact algebraic elimination of all eight equilibrium equations. The rodent subsystem yields a unique positive external force when its reproduction number exceeds one, and the human-contact parameter is a strictly increasing bijection of the positive infection force. The package includes a standard-library exact-rational verifier for eight model residuals, distinct equilibrium branches, and the sharp contact-prevalence endpoint. A self-review assessed correctness, originality and mathematical value; no independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact prevalence interval requires an endemic rodent subsystem (R_r>1), positive cross-species contact beta1 and otherwise fixed parameters; controlling reservoir or zoonotic transmission changes the lower bound.

Only nonnegative steady states of the specified deterministic, homogeneous-mixing, standard-incidence model are classified; no dynamical stability, global attraction, or empirical calibration is claimed.
The zero-human-contact and infinite-contact endpoints are mathematical limiting controls, not assertions of epidemiologically feasible interventions.
The three-type equilibrium taxonomy is known for other Mpox models; the source-specific sharp prevalence interval and exact inverse contact map are the central new claim.
title: Sharp human-prevalence control interval under a persistent Mpox rodent reservoir
